Hello! I love your art!

Could you draw my Original Character "ウクワ"? He is a grim reaper who is also a horologist. He is always concerned with time. He is nicknamed "White Rabbit" because he runs around screaming about being late.

He is usually very grumpy and stern.

ウクワ has a clock, hydrangea and moon motif.
Please draw him however you'd like!

Thank you so much for drawing Takeru and Tsuki before!

I'd be so happy if you could draw my "すばらしき世界" couple, Shou and Ukuwa! 

If this is too much, please draw Ukuwa on his own!

Ukuwa is a horologist and grim reaper with a hydrangea motif. He represents a white rabbit! He's very grumpy and he rushes around a lot. He's very concerned about time.

Shou is also a grim reaper and he is very strong. He represents a lion! He's loud and smug. He makes towers of trash and calls it art.

Shou and Ukuwa are on and off exes. Ukuwa broke up with Shou, but they keep coming back together. They are very into each other. Shou knows that Ukuwa likes him but Ukuwa is in denial. 

I don't have specific poses or expressions in mind but I will leave ideas in the folder! Thank you for your consideration!
